description: Vault's refusals that a caller acts on and that a bare status can't tell apart. A KV v2 write whose `cas` doesn't match answers 400 `check-and-set parameter did not match the current version` (hashicorp/vault-plugin-secrets-kv path_data.go, read 2026-11-01), which Vault's own docs tell clients to re-read and retry. A login during a lockout answers 429 `user is temporarily locked...` or `approle is temporarily locked due to too many failed login attempts`, has no Retry-After, and the docs say to stop retrying for 10 minutes (docs.stackit.cloud/products/security/secrets-manager/how-tos/handle-authentication-lockouts, read 2026-11-01): typed so it isn't the retryable TooManyRequests.
